reader.requirement: At COBOL-85, for a relative file whose connector is EXTERNAL, every file control entry of the run unit for that connector must specify the same access mode (an omitted clause being sequential), its RELATIVE KEY data-name-1 must be an external data item, and every entry's RELATIVE KEY must reference that same external data item; the compiler must refuse a violation it can see within the compilation group.

edition-consulted.switches: edition.Cite picks the §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR8 / §2002 / §2023 citation in the COBOL1624 and COBOL1575 text; the RELATIVE KEY not-external and same-item checks themselves run at every edition with Error severity

DialectLevel >= 2023 adds the FILE STATUS and LINAGE external-item rules and DialectLevel < 2002 adds CheckFileDescriptions (other rules, not this one); the access-mode agreement is the ACC segment of FileEntryIdentity.Segments at every edition

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the same checks and severities at 85 and 2023 (rk_one_missing refused with COBOL1575 at both, only the citation differs).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover access modes agreeing, the RELATIVE KEY at other character positions and under differently named groups; not exercised by them at 85: differing access modes (pb5069-external-access-mode-differs is a 2023-rule case), an omitted ACCESS clause against ACCESS SEQUENTIAL, a non-external key, a key in another external record or of another name, an entry with no RELATIVE KEY (probed here).

probes.printed: error COBOL6847: ... differ in the access mode
probes.expected: GR8: every entry must specify the same access mode (DYNAMIC vs RANDOM refused)

probes.printed: B[SECOND-REC] (accepted; omitted ACCESS against ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL)
probes.expected: GR1: omitted clause is sequential, so the modes agree; second sequential READ returns record 2

probes.printed: error COBOL1624: the RELATIVE KEY data item 'REL-KEY' shall be an external data item (ISO §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR8)
probes.expected: data-name-1 must reference an external data item

probes.printed: error COBOL1575 at the second entry
probes.expected: key in another external record is not the same external data item

probes.printed: error COBOL1575 at the second entry
probes.expected: RK2 is not the same external data item as REL-KEY
each entry's RELATIVE KEY phrase must reference that same item; an entry lacking it does not
elementary 01 EXTERNAL key shared: random READ and START/READ NEXT in dynamic mode use the shared key

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR8  (2.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8
OK  §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR1  (2.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1
OK  §1985:VIII.4.9.3 SR3  (4.9.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3

reader.notes: The compile-time reach is the compilation group; across separately compiled programs the run time's ExternalTable compares the entry fingerprint (which includes the access mode) but not the RELATIVE KEY item's identity, which 1985 states as a requirement on the run unit with no detection required. An entry with no RELATIVE KEY beside one that has it is refused; that reads 'the RELATIVE KEY phrase in each associated file control entry' as requiring the phrase in each, a reading the text supports but does not spell out.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 (E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-245/src/): rx_both_nokey2.cob (two programs of one compilation group, external relative file, ACCESS SEQUENTIAL with no RELATIVE KEY in one and no ACCESS clause in the other) compiled and ran A1[FIRST     ] A2[SECOND    ]: the refusal of the reader's rk_one_missing does not over-reach to entries that specify no RELATIVE KEY at all. rx_nested.cob (a contained program declaring the same external file DYNAMIC against RANDOM in its container) COBOL6847 access mode differs. rx_level01_vs_sub.cob (REL-KEY an 01 EXTERNAL item in one program, a subordinate of another external record in the other) COBOL1575 citing §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR8. cite: OK  §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR8  (2.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8; OK  §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR1  (2.4.4 General Rules). The cross-run-unit RELATIVE KEY identity is not checked at run time, but GR8 states a requirement on the run unit with no detection required.
